description: React component 'NoteList' for displaying, searching, filtering, and managing a list of notes in the NoteMaster Pro application. The component integrates with context, manages UI interactions like search debounce, note creation, and note actions (pin, favorite, delete), and renders the list with conditional states for loading and empty views.

methods.name: NoteList
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the note list panel with search, filter, and note management functionalities.
